title: Acme
web assessment
cover.subtitle: Three findings across the customer portal. One critical.
blurb: Testing covered the customer portal and the API behind it, from a clean unauthenticated start and from two customer accounts issued for the engagement.

blocks.para: Any customer can read any other customer's invoice. That is the only issue that needs fixing this week.

bullets: One critical issue, one high, no false positives.
Every issue reproduced twice from a clean account.
The report includes the exact requests, so the fixes can be verified.

callout.title: If you fix one thing
callout.text: Scope every invoice query by the session's account, and return 404 instead of 403 so the caller cannot enumerate what exists.

finding.title: Any customer can read any invoice
finding.what: The endpoint returns the invoice without checking who owns it. Changing the id in the request returns another account's billing data.
finding.impact: Billing data, addresses and invoice history for every customer are readable by any authenticated user.
fix: Scope the query by the session's account.

finding.title: Stored script injection in shipment notes
finding.what: Notes are stored verbatim and rendered with innerHTML on the operator console.
finding.impact: A customer account acts as an operator when a shipment is opened.
fix: Add a CSP that forbids inline script.

blocks.para: **Fix the ownership check first.** It is a single query change and the only issue with customer data exposed today.

numbered: Scope invoice reads by the session's account.
Deploy the CSP report-only, then enforce it.
Re-test both findings from a clean account.

rows: Sanitise shipment notes and add a CSP
